lines.en: label futabadorm30:
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait to see if she responds.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等着看她有没有回应。

lines.en: A few seconds go by without so much as a noise before I decide to try again.
lines.zh: 几秒过去了，一点动静都没有，我决定再试一次。

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba. Are you around right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba。你现在在吗？

lines.en: Huh.
lines.zh: 嗯。

lines.en: I guess she’s out?
lines.zh: 看来她出去了？

lines.en: That’s strange. Futaba is pretty much always in her dorm around this time.
lines.zh: 真奇怪。这个时间 Futaba 基本上都会在宿舍里。

lines.en: It’s a little later than normal today, too...so if she’s not here, maybe she’s out with Rin or...her one friend with the glasses or something??
lines.zh: 今天也比平时晚了一点……所以要是她不在，也许是和 Rin 出去了，或者……和她那个戴眼镜的唯一的朋友什么的？？

lines.en: I stare at the door for a few moments and focus on the handle.
lines.zh: 我盯着门看了一会儿，目光落在门把手上。

lines.en: I know from past experience that the residents of this room very rarely lock their door...so I {i}could{/i} go in and make sure she's okay.
lines.zh: 根据以往的经验，这间屋子的人极少锁门……所以我{i}可以{/i}进去确认她没事。

lines.en: That's certainly never backfired before.
lines.zh: 这种事当然从来没有出过岔子。

lines.en: Well, not with Futaba at least. But Futaba and I are a lot more {i}physically open{/i} with one another than Rin and I are...
lines.zh: 至少和 Futaba 之间没有。不过我和 Futaba 在{i}身体上{/i}要比我和 Rin 之间{i}开放{/i}得多……

lines.en: So I'm sure there wouldn't be any harm in me taking a peek inside.
lines.zh: 所以我敢肯定，我偷偷往里看一眼也不会有什么问题。

lines.en: It’s just a standard...wellness visit from someone who wasn’t {i}technically{/i} invited but would probably be allowed in nonetheless.
lines.zh: 这只是一次标准的……健康探望，来自一个{i}严格来说{/i}没被邀请、但大概还是会被放进门的人。

lines.en: : Fuck it.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。

lines.en: I decide to act on my immoral impulses and give into the curiosity beckoning me closer and closer to the door.
lines.zh: 我决定顺从自己不道德的冲动，屈从于那股把我一寸寸拉向房门的好奇心。

lines.en: if day < 6:
I’m sure I look like a fucking lunatic to the other girls in the hall right now, but I’m pretty sure they know by now that this is just what I’m like.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，此刻在走廊里的其他女孩眼里，我活像个疯子，不过我也挺确定她们早就知道我就是这样的人。

lines.en: else:
Thankfully, no one else is in the hallway to see me slowly inch toward a door that I was not granted permission to open.
lines.zh: 幸好走廊里没有别人，没人看见我一点点挪向一扇我并未获准打开的门。

lines.en: But even if someone was in the hall, I’m sure me doing something like this wouldn’t come as a complete shock.
lines.zh: 不过就算有人在，我敢肯定我干出这种事也不会让人完全意外。

lines.en: scene black
In times like these, it’s customary to say things like “Pardon the intrusion,” or “I’m coming in,” but I decide against both of those options.
lines.zh: 这种时候，按惯例该说些“打扰了”或者“我进来了”之类的话，可这两个选项我都放弃了。

lines.en: Because even if it's often worse, sometimes staying silent is the easiest option of all.
lines.zh: 因为尽管沉默常常更糟，但有时候它反而是最省事的选择。

lines.en: scene futabasleep1
Behold, the reason Futaba did not answer the door tonight.
lines.zh: 瞧，这就是 Futaba 今晚没来开门的原因。

lines.en: She’s already asleep.
lines.zh: 她已经睡着了。

lines.en: I wonder if that's why Rin isn't here either? Maybe she's just trying to let her rest or something?
lines.zh: 我猜这大概也是 Rin 不在的原因？也许她只是想让她好好休息之类的？

lines.en: I know Futaba has been spending extra time at the library lately, so I start to wonder if maybe she’s been...overworking herself.
lines.zh: 我知道 Futaba 最近在图书馆待的时间变多了，于是我开始怀疑她是不是……把自己累坏了。

lines.en: I'm not sure how one manages to overwork themself at a {i}library,{/i} but I guess that too much of anything can take a toll on the body.
lines.zh: 我不太明白一个人要怎么在{i}图书馆{/i}里把自己累垮，不过我想任何事做过头都会伤身。

lines.en: : Nnh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: She moans lightly in her sleep- the type of moan you make when you allow yourself to be swallowed by comfort rather than stress.
lines.zh: 她在睡梦中轻轻呻吟了一声——那种被舒适而非压力吞没时会发出的呻吟。

lines.en: It’s funny, though....Because she doesn’t look very comfortable.
lines.zh: 不过说来好笑……因为她看起来一点也不舒服。

lines.en: She looks pretty hot actually.
lines.zh: 其实她看起来很热。

lines.en: And I don't just mean that in the “I want to climb into bed with her” way.
lines.zh: 而且我说的“热”，不只是“我想爬上床和她一起”那种。

lines.en: Her face is beet-red and she’s dripping sweat.
lines.zh: 她的脸涨得通红，还在冒汗。

lines.en: I think back to the beach trip when Futaba decided to leave early due to...slightly mysterious circumstances.
lines.zh: 我想起那次海边之行，Futaba 因为……有点神秘的状况提前离开了。

lines.en: I remember Rin saying that it was because she wasn’t feeling well, so...
lines.zh: 我记得 Rin 说那是因为她身体不舒服，所以……

lines.en: Could this be more of that?
lines.zh: 这会不会又是同样的情况？

lines.en: Part of me knows that I shouldn't disturb her when she's sleeping.
lines.zh: 我的一部分清楚，她睡着的时候我不该打扰。

lines.en: But another part of me does anyway.
lines.zh: 可另一部分的我还是这么做了。

lines.en: : Futaba...Wake up.
lines.zh: : Futaba……醒醒。

lines.en: : Mmn...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯……

lines.en: I know the last thing you're supposed to do for a sick person is tear them from their rest, but...well, I guess I'm still hoping that she isn't sick at all.
lines.zh: 我知道对病人来说，最不该做的就是把他们从休息中拽起来，可是……嗯，我想我还在盼着她根本没生病。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: I poke her arm in true asshole fashion and force her out of her slumber in order to feel better about myself for coming all the way over here.
lines.zh: 我以十足混蛋的方式戳了戳她的胳膊，硬把她从睡梦中弄醒，好让自己为跑了这一趟而心里好受点。

lines.en: scene futabasleep2
: S...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : S……Sensei？……

lines.en: : Hey.
: Hey...
scene futabasleep3
: Wait, why are you in my room?!
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么在我房间里？！

lines.en: : I didn’t know you were coming over!
lines.zh: : 我都不知道你要来！

lines.en: : I knocked on the door a few times and you didn’t answer. I just wanted to confirm you were still alive.
lines.zh: : 我敲了好几次门你都没应。我只是想确认你还活着。

lines.en: : You almost gave me a heart attack...
lines.zh: : 你差点把我吓出心脏病……

lines.en: : Are you feeling okay? It looks like you’re burning up.
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？你看起来烧得很厉害。

lines.en: scene futabasleep4
: I’m fine...
lines.zh: : 我没事……

lines.en: : How are you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : I’m also fine, but I don’t think there’s any reason to believe {i}I{/i} wouldn’t be right now.
lines.zh: : 我也很好，不过我觉得现在没理由认为{i}我{/i}会不好。

lines.en: : So...I take it that means you have...reason to believe {i}I’m{/i} lying to you?
lines.zh: : 所以……这么说，你有……理由认为{i}我{/i}在骗你？

lines.en: : I suppose it does.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : It’s not like you to keep things from me. What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 你不像是会对我有所隐瞒的人。怎么回事？

lines.en: : Are you sick?
lines.zh: : 你生病了？

lines.en: scene futabasleep5
: No...The air conditioner is just broken...And I don't...particularly enjoy sleeping without my clothes on, so...
lines.zh: : 不是……只是空调坏了……而且我……不太喜欢不穿衣服睡觉，所以……

lines.en: : Would you enjoy it any more if {i}I{/i} took my clothes off and laid with you?
lines.zh: : 那要是{i}我{/i}脱光了陪你躺下，你会更享受吗？

lines.en: scene futabasleep6
: Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不怎么更享受，不会。

lines.en: : I highly doubt you’d just...let me sleep if we were naked...
lines.zh: : 我很怀疑如果我们都光着，你会就这么……让我睡觉……

lines.en: : I apparently have trouble letting you sleep even when we aren’t, so you’re probably right.
lines.zh: : 看来就算我们没光着，我也很难让你睡着，所以你大概是对的。

lines.en: scene futabasleep4
: Umm...if you’re really...that insistent on helping me, can you get me a bottle of water from under my desk?
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果你真的……那么坚持要帮我，能帮我从桌子下面拿瓶水吗？

lines.en: : Is this for drinking or do you want me to pour it over your head to try and cool you down?
lines.zh: : 这是拿来喝的，还是你想让我把它浇到你头上帮你降温？

lines.en: : For drinking, obviously...It would be a little harder to sleep if my pillow was soaking wet.
lines.zh: : 当然是拿来喝的……要是枕头湿透了，睡觉会难很多。

lines.en: : Got it. Stay right there.
lines.zh: : 明白了。别动。

lines.en: scene black
I walk over to Futaba’s desk and grab her a bottle of water.
lines.zh: 我走到 Futaba 的桌边，给她拿了一瓶水。

lines.en: She decides to immediately go against my words of advice and sits up on the bed, straightening out her pajamas and doing her best to keep herself propped up.
lines.zh: 她立刻违背了我的叮嘱，在床上坐了起来，整理好睡衣，尽力让自己坐直。

lines.en: I sit down next to her and hand her the bottle only to have her immediately slump down against me and start gently sipping away.
lines.zh: 我在她旁边坐下，把水递给她，结果她立刻瘫靠在我身上，小口小口地喝了起来。

lines.en: scene futabasleep7
: Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : I feel bad that you came all the way over here just to take care of me, but...
lines.zh: : 你大老远跑过来只为照顾我，我挺过意不去的，不过……

lines.en: : I guess having you do that can count as...punishment for walking into a girl’s room without knocking.
lines.zh: : 我想，让你这么做，可以算作……你没敲门就闯进女生房间的惩罚。

lines.en: : I did knock. Several times.
lines.zh: : 我敲了。敲了好几次。

lines.en: : If a tree falls in the forest and no one is around to hear it, does it make a sound?
lines.zh: : 如果一棵树在森林里倒下，而周围没有人听见，它算发出声音了吗？

lines.en: : Yes. It does.
lines.zh: : 算。当然算。

lines.en: : I never understood why people ask that question.
lines.zh: : 我一直不明白人们为什么要问这个问题。

lines.en: : How would a lack of people being there to observe something translate to that thing not happening at all?
lines.zh: : 没有人目睹某件事，怎么会等于那件事根本没发生过呢？

lines.en: : Just look at the universe. No one was there to see it form and we all know how it happened.
lines.zh: : 就拿宇宙来说吧。没有人亲眼看见它形成，可我们都知道它是怎么来的。

lines.en: {s}With a fleshlight and gallons of celestial cum.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}用一个飞机杯和好几加仑的天界精液。{/s}

lines.en: scene futabasleep8
: Keep talking...I like the sound of your voice.
lines.zh: : 继续说……我喜欢你的声音。

lines.en: : You should monologue around me more often...
lines.zh: : 你应该多在我面前独白才对……

lines.en: : Should I? I normally just keep them inside.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我平时都只是放在心里。

lines.en: : I think so. You have a really...interesting outlook on all sorts of things, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我觉得是。你对各种各样的事情都有很……有意思的看法，Sensei……

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I can't imagine you or anyone else ever benefitting from my self-indulgent ramblings.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我想象不出你或者其他任何人能从我的自说自话里得到什么好处。

lines.en: : But we’re not here to talk about me.
lines.zh: : 不过我们不是来聊我的。

lines.en: : You're right. I’m here to sleep, but apparently I’m not allowed to do that right now.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我是来睡觉的，可显然现在不被允许睡觉。

lines.en: : Correct. Not until you tell me what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 没错。在你告诉我怎么回事之前，不行。

lines.en: : You don’t have some sort of contagious disease that I’m going to contract now, do you? Because, if so, I should probably just go.
lines.zh: : 你该不会有什么会传染给我的病吧？因为要是有的话，我大概该走了。

lines.en: : Yes, I have a very contagious disease and you should leave so I can go back to sleep.
lines.zh: : 是的，我得了传染性很强的病，你该走了，好让我继续睡。

lines.en: : If you were any good at lying, you actually might have had a chance to fool me there.
lines.zh: : 要是你的撒谎技术好一点，说不定还真有可能骗到我。

lines.en: scene futabasleep9
: Why {i}lie{/i} when it's so much easier to just...hide the truth?
lines.zh: : 既然藏着真相要容易得多，为什么要{i}撒谎{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Interesting. That sounds like something I would say.
lines.zh: : 有意思。这话听起来像是我会说的话。

lines.en: : Maybe you {i}can{/i} benefit from some of my monologues after all?
lines.zh: : 也许你终究还是{i}能{/i}从我的独白里得到点什么？

lines.en: : You should still tell me what you’re hiding, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你还是该告诉我你在藏什么。

lines.en: : Should I?
lines.zh: : 该吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: What’s in it for me if I do?...
lines.zh: : 我要是说了，有什么好处？……

lines.en: : A...book?
lines.zh: : 一……本书？

lines.en: : You like those, right?...
lines.zh: : 你喜欢书吧？……

lines.en: scene futabasleep10
: This is the one time I choose to give you the opening to say something dirty and you offer me a book?
lines.zh: : 我好不容易给你一次说点下流话的机会，你就拿一本书来打发我？

lines.en: : Well, what else am I supposed to do? Every time I offer to do something sexual for {i}you{/i}, you back off.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我还能怎么办？每次我说要为{i}你{/i}做点性感的事，你都往后退。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think you’re just afraid and I don't want to push my luck tonight when I've already overstayed my welcome.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得你只是害怕，而今晚我已经待得够久了，不想得寸进尺。

lines.en: scene futabasleep11
: Isn’t something like that a normal thing to be afraid of, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，害怕这种事不是很正常吗？

lines.en: : Doing things you’ve never done before?
lines.zh: : 做自己从没做过的事？

lines.en: : Like...weren’t you nervous the first time I touched your penis?
lines.zh: : 比如……我第一次碰你鸡巴的时候，你难道不紧张吗？

lines.en: : Not at all. I thought it was pretty awesome, actually.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。说实话，我觉得那感觉棒极了。

lines.en: : Well, you’re very welcome. But yes, I am afraid of all sorts of new things.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那不用客气。不过是的，我对各种新鲜事物都害怕。

lines.en: : Not because I’m worried about how it will feel or anything-
lines.zh: : 不是因为担心感觉如何之类的——

lines.en: : But more because I’m worried of what you’ll think of me after.
lines.zh: : 更多是因为我担心事后你会怎么看我。

lines.en: if futabadorm25 == True:
: Well first off, I’ve already told you that I’m not going to just abandon you after I have my way with you.
lines.zh: : 首先，我说过了，我不会在得手之后就把你丢掉。

lines.en: : The word choice there makes me worry even more, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你那个用词让我更担心了，Sensei。

lines.en: else:
: Well first off, I’d never just toss you aside after seeing what you look like on the receiving end. Quite the opposite, actually.
lines.zh: : 首先，在看过你在被对待那一端是什么样子之后，我绝不会把你丢开。事实上恰恰相反。

lines.en: : And second, what does that have to do with you hiding your mystery-sickness from me?
lines.zh: : 其次，这跟你要对我隐瞒你的神秘病症有什么关系？

lines.en: : Maybe I’m just really hot because I’m turned on?
lines.zh: : 也许我这么热只是因为有感觉了？

lines.en: : Did you also leave the beach because you were turned on?
lines.zh: : 那你离开海边也是因为有感觉了？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabasleep12
: It’s just a fever. Stop worrying so much.
lines.zh: : 只是发烧而已。别这么担心了。

lines.en: : I probably overworked myself at the library or...stress is just getting to me. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我大概是在图书馆累着了，或者……只是压力太大。我不知道。

lines.en: : It’s not a big deal. I already told you to not bother worrying about it. I’m sure I’ll be fine in a day or two.
lines.zh: : 没什么大不了的。我说过不用替我操心了。我敢肯定一两天就会好。

lines.en: That does fit the bill for what I imagined, but...
lines.zh: 这倒符合我之前的猜测，可是……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: Something still seems wrong.
lines.zh: 总觉得哪里不对劲。

lines.en: : If I find out you have cancer or something, I’m punching you in the face.
lines.zh: : 要是我发现你得了癌症什么的，我就往你脸上来一拳。

lines.en: scene futabasleep13
: You’d...punch a cancer-patient in the face?
lines.zh: : 你……会往一个癌症病人脸上打？

lines.en: : I’d punch a liar in the face.
lines.zh: : 我会往一个骗子脸上打。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Actually, I don’t think I’d hit you under any circumstances.
lines.zh: : 其实我想，任何情况下我都不会打你。

lines.en: : But I do want you to know that you shouldn’t be afraid of hiding your-
lines.zh: : 不过我确实想让你知道，你不该害怕对我隐瞒你的——

lines.en: scene futabasleep9
: Fever.
lines.zh: : 发烧。

lines.en: : It’s just a fever.
lines.zh: : 只是发烧而已。

lines.en: : I get them pretty often, too. So if it happens in the future, the best thing you can do is just...ask me if I need soup or something.
lines.zh: : 我也经常发烧。所以以后再发生这种事，你最该做的就是……问我需不需要汤什么的。

lines.en: : What you’re doing now is more than enough.
lines.zh: : 你现在做的已经够多了。

lines.en: : I mean...sure. You’re not letting me rest when that’s a better medicine than anything else but...you’re worried.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……当然。你不让我休息，可休息比什么药都管用，不过……你是在担心。

lines.en: : Self-centered, too. But definitely worried.
lines.zh: : 而且还有点自我中心。但确实是在担心。

lines.en: : Am I being called out right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在是被怼了吗？

lines.en: scene futabasleep15
: A little.
lines.zh: : 有一点。

lines.en: : I get kind of grumpy when I’m woken up. Let this be a lesson to you.
lines.zh: : 我被吵醒的时候脾气会有点差。你就当是个教训吧。

lines.en: : Wow. It's not every day I see smug expressions like that out of you.
lines.zh: : 哇。你摆出这种得意的表情可不多见。

lines.en: scene futabasleep14
: I guess I just save them for special moments like this.
lines.zh: : 我想我只是把它们留给了像这样的特别时刻。

lines.en: Futaba nuzzles her head against my shoulder and relaxes her posture.
lines.zh: Futaba 把头蹭到我的肩膀上，放松了姿势。

lines.en: I wish I could say something like, “I feel her skin grow colder as she calms down,” but I’m afraid I can’t.
lines.zh: 我真希望能说些“我感觉到她的皮肤随着她平静下来而变凉”之类的话，可惜我说不出口。

lines.en: She remains burning up for the rest of my visit.
lines.zh: 在我接下来的探望里，她一直烫得厉害。

lines.en: scene black
I wind up leaving after another ten minutes or so.
lines.zh: 又过了十来分钟，我最终还是离开了。

lines.en: Eventually, I’m talked into feeling bad about interrupting her slumber, so I do the responsible thing and get out of there.
lines.zh: 最后，我被说服了，为打扰她睡觉而感到愧疚，于是做了件负责任的事：走人。

lines.en: I hope I didn’t add to whatever mystery ailment is afflicting her.
lines.zh: 希望我没有加重那个折磨着她的神秘病痛。

lines.en: I’d hate to be the cause of more problems, even if it seems like I’m going out of my way to create them more often than not.
lines.zh: 我可不想成为更多麻烦的源头，哪怕我似乎常常在专门制造麻烦。

lines.en: But, at the end of the day-
lines.zh: 但说到底——

lines.en: Futaba is important to me.
lines.zh: Futaba 对我来说很重要。

lines.en: She’s a lovely young girl and I wish her the speediest of recoveries.
lines.zh: 她是个可爱的年轻女孩，我希望她能尽快康复。
